headline: World Shipping Council Highlights Growth in Renewable Marine Fuel Fleet Demand
summary: A World Shipping Council report indicates that vessels capable of using renewable marine fuels will account for over 20% of liner energy demand by 2030, driven by investments in new container ships.
why: Adoption rates of dual-fuel container ships signal long-term structural shifts toward green energy infrastructure within global container shipping.

impacts.name: Maritime Shipping
impacts.why: Fleet investments create expanding demand markets for alternative marine fuels.
